# Stanzi Studio

> Miami venture studio. We build businesses, then build the AI systems and
> operations that run them. Ventures are created and operated in-house;
> consulting is for people who actually operate.

Founded by Franco Stanzione. Fourteen years opening, operating and fixing
hospitality businesses — then automating them. We don't advise, we operate:
we architect the business and the systems that run it, and stay on the floor
until the machine runs without us.

## What we do

- **Ventures** — we create and launch businesses from zero, in-house.
- **Systems & Operations** — we architect the machine so the business runs without us.
- **AI & Automation** — we put agents and automations on the floor, so the operation runs itself and reports back.
- **Brand & Growth** — we build demand and turn operations into leverage.
- **Software** — we ship the tools that run the operation.

## In-house ventures

- **Stanzione Italian Specialties** — two locations plus catering; named among the top 50 pizzerias in the US.
- **Opstable** — restaurant workforce SaaS, with an AI gateway an operator's assistant can call.
- **Hey Chef** — voice AI for the kitchen line (in beta).
- **FittrAI** — AI coaching, built in-house.

Track record before the studio: Stanzione '87, Ash Pizza, Thoroughbred Pizza.

## Selected consulting work

- **Barrio Pizza** — concept, brand and construction through team training and operational systems; scaled to multi-unit, founder exited.
- **Brightline** — hospitality operating partnership; venue operations inside a national rail brand.
- **The Foundry Miami** — menu and recipe development, vendor procurement, training.
- **Kiki Hospitality** — concept creation.
- **Sunshine Coffee** — staffing, logistics, permitting.
- **Events & Activations** — Art Basel, Hong Kong Tourism Board, SCAD, Emilio Pucci, Mutto Furniture, Miami Beach Botanical Garden.

## Proof

- 6x weekly revenue at one location, inside twelve months of systems work.
- 11 tools live on our own AI gateway, so an operator's assistant can read the business directly.
- 5 automations running invoicing, tax and reporting across two restaurants, unattended.
- 14 years opening, operating and fixing hospitality businesses.
